rationale: The N7.4.E acceptance explicitly permits documented N/A.
N7.4.D changed backend application/infrastructure replay semantics only; it did not add an API controller action or any frontend surface.

The existing MensajesOutboxController exposes registration only. It has no GET/list/history/retry/orchestration contract from which a tenant UI could provide inspection, persisted history, explainability or assisted orchestration.

The frontend tree contains no outbox-named screen/service/route. Building a functional UI that satisfies the stated acceptance would first require a new backend read/orchestration contract, which is outside this FRONTEND_UX parent and would expand scope.
Therefore the safe, causal outcome for N7.4.E is documented N/A rather than filler UI or an unauthorized backend API expansion.
